description: §19.16.2 (S430 round 4) — a deferred statement that raises a HOST error does not stop the block's other deferred statements: they still run, LIFO, and the first host error is rethrown after all of them. work(): "work;", then at exit last-registered, then boom (throws a TypeError after writing "boom;"), then first-registered STILL runs: trace = "work;last-registered;boom;first-registered;".
rationale: §19.16.2: a host error inside a deferred body does not prevent the block's remaining deferred bodies from running; after all have run, the first such error propagates (the runner rethrows it).
